body.x: Fairip has presented GAK KSL & ESL, a VR language education system, in CES 2019 ‘Design & Source & MIK NIGHT’, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).
Fairip, established in 2017 April, focuses on language education service through a new media, VR which stands for Virtual Reality.

GAK KSL & ESL, a self-developed VR English education system, teaches pronunciation through 360° view of video and shows a video of related vocabulary which helps to infer the meaning of the vocabulary.

According to one of the authorities of Fairip, “The learning process is not just based on reading and writing, it is learning through direct experience under the use of VR environment which is greatly effective”. As the result of the study experiment in investigated in 5 domestic middle schools shows, there was 30% enhancement in the grade of 95% of the students.

The authority further added that “Fairip is in the process of preparing product for Korean language educating VR. Through this show, we are aiming to advance into markets in America, European countries and Southeast Asia”.
